data.content_ref: inline:The integration relation asserts SRC_001, SRC_003, and SRC_005 share a commitment to treating the proportionality/covering principle as 'a real, defeasible assumption rather than an axiom,' with SRC_003 supplying the epistemic modality and SRC_001/SRC_005 supplying a pedagogical mechanism. But this conflates two distinct kinds of defeasibility into one 'shared mechanism': SRC_003's defeasibility is epistemic (expectation vs. entailment — a modal distinction about what follows logically), whereas SRC_001/SRC_005's 'mechanism that renders the assumption invisible by construction' is pedagogical (how the framing conceals an assumption from the solver). These are not the same mechanism — invisibility-by-construction and epistemic-modality-attribution operate on entirely different levels (curriculum design vs. logical semantics). Calling their combination an 'integration' names no causal pathway through which the pedagogical concealment and the epistemic modality reinforce each other; it merely lists them as co-occurring. The 'refuted if their mechanisms are merely topically similar without a shared commitment' clause is triggered by the target's own content, since the only shared thing is the abstract word 'defeasible' applied to different objects.
